verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that Secureframe runs its own MCP server, which external MCP clients such as Claude Code and Cursor connect to. That is the opposite role from this story. Nothing in the pack shows Secureframe's own AI features (Comply AI) connecting to or using tools from user-supplied MCP servers, and its custom integrations are API and CSV data ingestion, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
